updates.note: Management reaffirmed the 19% to 21% EBITDA margin range.
updates.quote: And as we keep telling, we are very happy with the 19% to 21% EBITDA. And we are very confident we can be in that range.

updates.note: Management reiterated the 4% to 4.5% full-year marketing budget.
updates.quote: And as regards to marketing expenses, for the year, we generally maintain a 4%, 4.5% budget.

updates.note: No mention of general trade outlet addition numbers in this call.

new_promises.statement: Plan to spend around INR140 crores in FY '26 on capex.
new_promises.quote: We plan to spend around INR140 crores in FY '26, out of which in H1, we have spent around INR57 crores.
new_promises.speaker: Deepanjan Bandyopadhyay
